<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913852_theRebbe_463" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913852_theRebbe_463__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the perfection achieved through human service began on the sixth day of creation with Adam's work on himself and the world, and is elevated further through the giving of the Torah and especially on Rosh HaShanah, which each year draws a new and higher light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this perfection that is brought about through the service of man began on the sixth day of Creation, when man was created and began to work the ground,</t>
    <t s="1">first the ground that is within man himself,</t>
    <t s="2">"And Hashem Elokim formed the man, dust from the ground"58,</t>
    <t s="3">and afterwards, and through this, also the ground that is outside of him,</t>
    <t s="4">namely the entire order of the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="5">(for everything was from the dust59),</t>
    <t s="6">and as mentioned, he effected in all of creation the matter of "Come, let us bow down and kneel, let us bend the knee before Hashem our Maker."</t>
    <t s="7">And particularly after the sixth day of the Giving of the Torah</t>
    <t s="8">[for then an elevation and perfection was made in the sixth day of the Act of Creation60],</t>
    <t s="9">that the service of man and the effect in the world</t>
    <t s="10">(which is brought about through his service)</t>
    <t s="11">after the Giving of the Torah is in a more elevated manner.</t>
    <t s="12">And particularly on Rosh HaShanah,</t>
    <t s="13">"This day is the beginning of Your works,"</t>
    <t s="14">which is analogous to the beginning of Your works that was brought about through the service of Adam the First on the first Rosh HaShanah,</t>
    <t s="15">and even more so,</t>
    <t s="16">and in Rosh HaShanah itself, behold, in each and every year this matter is in a more elevated manner,</t>
    <t s="17">as per the commandment61</t>
    <t s="18">"We ascend in holiness,"</t>
    <t s="19">until on each Rosh HaShanah a new, higher light is drawn down that had not yet shone from the days of the world, such a supernal light62,</t>
    <t s="20">and until the Redemption, when "the breaker will go up before us"63</t>
    <t s="21">and will break through all measurements and limitations.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the three Rosh HaShanah themes—Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros—correspond respectively to the immanent light, the transcendent light, and the inner essence of Ein Sof, paralleling the three concepts of the beginning of works, the remembrance of the first day, and the revelation of essential delight.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, the three matters mentioned above that are drawn down on Rosh HaShanah</t>
    <t s="2">(the beginning of Your works,</t>
    <t s="3">remembrance of the first day</t>
    <t s="4">(the revelation of the desire for kindness),</t>
    <t s="5">and the drawing down of the revelation of the essential delight that is above the desire for kindness)</t>
    <t s="6">are</t>
    <t s="7">(in a manner of)</t>
    <t s="8">the three matters of Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros.</t>
    <t s="9">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="10">that Malchiyos is in the aspect of the immanent, filling all worlds</t>
    <t s="11">(as explained in the aforementioned discourse of the Tzemach Tzedek64),</t>
    <t s="12">a light that is valued by the worlds, to which the arousal from below reaches,</t>
    <t s="13">and this is what is said: "Recite before Me Malchiyos, so that you make Me King over you"65,</t>
    <t s="14">for just as the matter of kingship below is brought about by the people, as it is written66</t>
    <t s="15">"You shall surely set a king over you,"</t>
    <t s="16">so too is it in the kingship of heaven67,</t>
    <t s="17">that this—that the Holy One, blessed be He, becomes King—is through "you shall make Me King,"</t>
    <t s="18">that Israel accept upon themselves the yoke of the kingdom of heaven and request "Reign..." etc.</t>
    <t s="19">[for in this request and acceptance is also included the request that He decree decrees upon us, and the acceptance of the yoke of commandments68,</t>
    <t s="20">to fulfill all that He will decree and command in the manner of acceptance of the yoke,</t>
    <t s="21">and as per the wording of the blessing of</t>
    <t s="22">(all)</t>
    <t s="23">the commandments, "Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us,"</t>
    <t s="24">that the fulfillment of the commandments is by virtue of the command and decree69],</t>
    <t s="25">through which the Holy One, blessed be He, becomes King over all of Israel,</t>
    <t s="26">"so that you make Me King over you,"</t>
    <t s="27">and through them also King over all the earth.</t>
    <t s="28">And this—that through the service of Israel they arouse the matter of kingship—is,</t>
    <t s="29">for the matter of kingship is</t>
    <t s="30">(generally)</t>
    <t s="31">in the light that fills,</t>
    <t s="32">that an arousal from below reaches there.</t>
    <t s="33">And it is analogous to the matter of "the beginning of Your works."</t>
    <t s="34">And although on Rosh HaShanah all things return to their primordial state,</t>
    <t s="35">and the drawing down of kingship on Rosh HaShanah is from the Essence of Ein Sof that is above the matter of kingship</t>
    <t s="36">[and this—that it is in the power of Israel to draw down from the Essence of Ein Sof—is because they are rooted in the Essence70,</t>
    <t s="37">and analogous to what is explained in Likkutei Torah71,</t>
    <t s="38">that this—that it is within the capacity of Israel to arouse the revelation of His kingship, may He be blessed, from His Essence and Being—is by virtue of the covenant which Hashem has cut with us, to be a people for Him72,</t>
    <t s="39">that they should be similar to the King,</t>
    <t s="40">people like Him],</t>
    <t s="41">behold, this is that the root of the drawing down is from the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="42">but the drawing down itself is that the matter of kingship is drawn down73,</t>
    <t s="43">which generally is the immanent, filling all worlds.</t>
    <t s="44">And the matter of Zichronos is in the Ein Sof that encompasses all worlds74,</t>
    <t s="45">which is holy and separate from the worlds.</t>
    <t s="46">For the matter of remembrance applies only to something distant,</t>
    <t s="47">in place or in level,</t>
    <t s="48">to the extent that the thing does not occupy a place relative to Him.</t>
    <t s="49">And this is that Zichronos is in the Essence of Ein Sof, for "everything before Him is considered as nothing"75.</t>
    <t s="50">And it is analogous to the matter of "remembrance of the first day"76.</t>
    <t s="51">However, even so, the matter of remembrance applies specifically to something that exists in reality even before one remembers it</t>
    <t s="52">(except that the thing is distant from him in place and level).</t>
    <t s="53">And this is that Zichronos is in the aspect of the encompassing,</t>
    <t s="54">for even regarding the encompassing, there is the existence of worlds</t>
    <t s="55">(only that they are in a distant place,</t>
    <t s="56">for they are considered as absolutely nothing)77.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Shofros draws from the innermost essence of Ein Sof, beyond even the encompassing level, corresponding to the essential delight that is above the desire for kindness, reaching the King's delight in His very Self.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the matter of Shofros is as explained in the aforementioned discourse of the Tzemach Tzedek78,</t>
    <t s="1">that the voice of the shofar is an inner voice from the aspect of the innerness of the heart,</t>
    <t s="2">from which it is understood,</t>
    <t s="3">that the drawing down through the shofar is from the innerness and Essence of Ein Sof that is above even the encompassing79.</t>
    <t s="4">And as it is written80,</t>
    <t s="5">"To You my heart said, 'Seek My face'; Your face, Hashem, I will seek,"</t>
    <t s="6">that through "Seek My face,"</t>
    <t s="7">the cry of the innerness of the heart,</t>
    <t s="8">through this "Your face, Hashem, I will seek,"</t>
    <t s="9">the drawing down from the innerness and Essence of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="10">And it is analogous to the drawing down and revelation of the essential delight that is above even the matter of the desire for kindness.</t>
    <t s="11">And particularly according to what is known81,</t>
    <t s="12">that shofar</t>
    <t s="13">(from the term "improve your deeds"82)</t>
    <t s="14">is delight,</t>
    <t s="15">and the aspect of the delight of the shofar is the source of delights,</t>
    <t s="16">until the King's delight in His very Essence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
